exposure: Induction of Labor (using transcervical balloon catheter and oxytocin)
outcome: Autonomy and control over labor and birth
cohort: Pregnant persons with a history of 1 or 2 previous cesarean births and no contraindication to vaginal birth, including a specific case of a pregnant person with 2 prior CBs requiring labor induction.
finding: Labor after Cesarean (LAC), including when labor is induced using a transcervical balloon catheter and oxytocin, is a safe and beneficial option for pregnant persons with a history of 1 or 2 prior cesarean births, offering reduced complications and improved autonomy.
mod_finding: Vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) is a safe alternative to repeat cesarean birth, reducing short- and long-term health complications and morbidity.
